bundle.longDescription: Clipier finds the AI coding CLIs installed on your machine (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode) and lets you use them from one place: a conversation you can continue with another agent, one brief sent to several agents at once, and a plan carried out by a crew of them in parallel. Your checkout is never touched by a race or a crew.
